ties: remainder: exact shares rounded only at the end can answer like a rotation that starts with the payer, so both count as even-over-repeats (the raw observations are kept per build)
remainder: first-listed-fixed and first-in-join-order coincide on the probe (list order = join order)
acceptMethod: reference apps (.worker-scratch/refapps, to be committed with the report): one decision varied at a time, the others fixed at even-over-repeats / listed-only / group-net; a scenario that changes result tests the decision; an answer is accepted when it passes all of them

rules.valid: answers among the registered options; other and blocked are missing, never merged
rules.M: both builder models strong, modes differ, and each model's scenario drafts include >= 1 set identifying the decision, all identifying sets point at that model's builder mode, and non-identifying (not untested) sets allow it
rules.notM: both builder models strong with the same mode
rules.noPreference: either model has no strong preference
rules.undecidable: everything else, including a model without an identifying scenario set; no automatic extra K
rules.R: remainder only: in settle-c1 a model's mode differs from settle-a1 or stops being strong -> R supported; both modes unchanged and strong -> no effect of the sentence observed in this comparison

statedBeforeBuilds: remainder: the sonnet scenario sets do not identify it (b1 untested, b2 accepts three answers), so the drafter side of M is undecidable for remainder whatever the builders do; the builder-side counts are still reported
payer-in-shares and netting: all four scenario sets identify listed-only and group-net
